metric: Standardized estimated inference cost, not invoices, fixed subscriptions, or cross-family quality equivalence
decision_overhead: Jev calls use reported per-attempt cost_usd_ticks / 1e10 and are included once, including calls owned by children. Missing receipts are unknown, not zero.
free_worker_cost: Every free-model call must have a reported zero-cost receipt; no paid worker substitution.
deepseek_cost: Same fixed public catalog rates applied to Codex and Distill token counts. Native Codex exposes no OpenRouter invoice/generation cost; estimates are not billed charges.
native_claude_cost: Use Claude Code reported costBasis=list API-equivalent costUSD per model. Native modelUsage lacks a 5m/1h cache-write split; never silently assume 5m. Distill uses explicit sampler cache_creation_1h_prompt_tokens.
credential_path_redaction: Private account identifiers in authentication-file paths are placeholders; original local commands remain in raw task artifacts.
